scientific_integrity: The analytical proof is fully given; exact bounded verification is corroborative and is not represented as an infinite proof. The general in-in cut formula and classical cubical edge-isoperimetry are credited. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted Euclidean realization only. General weighted cube-graph zonotopes, volume and complete center-set face vectors are outside the theorem; priority remains provisional.
title: A dimension-six insphere and rigidity transition in cubical in-in zonotopes
